brands.name: High Noon
brands.claim: Complete any Run or Set; grant the opponent one charge.
brands.power: Draw two, keep one, and return the other to the wall.
brands.upgrade: Inspect three draws before choosing one.

brands.name: River
brands.claim: Complete a Run from an opponent discard.
brands.power: Recover one of your two latest discards.
brands.upgrade: Recover one of your three latest discards.

brands.name: Homestead
brands.unlock: Win a Trail Rules rematch against River Rose.
brands.claim: Complete a matching Set from an opponent discard.
brands.power: Place a tile in the Corral and draw a replacement; recover it on a later draw.
brands.upgrade: The Corral can hold two tiles.

brands.name: Hospitality
brands.unlock: Win a Trail Rules rematch against Dynamite Bill.
brands.claim: Establish the hand's Pair from an opponent discard.
brands.power: Offer a tile to the neutral exchange and draw a replacement.
brands.upgrade: The neutral exchange can hold two offers before a swap.

brands.name: Night
brands.unlock: Win a Trail Rules rematch against Mayor Bell.
brands.claim: Deny an opponent discard before it can be claimed.
brands.power: Mark the latest opposing discard unclaimable.
brands.upgrade: The denial also grants one replacement draw.

brands.name: Omen
brands.unlock: Complete the Hall cleanup and reopen the Frontier table.
brands.claim: Reserve a marked discard until the next turn.
brands.power: Inspect and reorder the next three wall tiles.
brands.upgrade: Inspect and reorder the next four wall tiles.
